nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the shadcn-svelte Tabs UI component, re-exporting the Root, List, Trigger, and Content parts under both primitive and namespaced aliases along with the tabsListVariants styling helper.
nodes.languageNotes: Aggregates Svelte component parts and re-exports them with paired aliases (e.g. Root/Tabs, Content/TabsContent) following the shadcn-svelte convention.

nodes.name: tabs.svelte
nodes.summary: Root Tabs component wrapping bits-ui TabsPrimitive.Root with bindable ref/value props and orientation-aware layout classes.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 5 runes: uses $props(), $bindable() for ref and value, and merges class names via the cn utility.

nodes.name: tabs-list.svelte
nodes.summary: Tabs list container wrapping bits-ui TabsPrimitive.List, exposing a default/line variant via a tailwind-variants (tv) styling definition exported as tabsListVariants.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level <script module> block exports the tabsListVariants tv() config and the derived TabsListVariant type using tailwind-variants VariantProps.

nodes.name: tabs-trigger.svelte
nodes.summary: Individual tab trigger button wrapping bits-ui TabsPrimitive.Trigger with extensive Tailwind classes for active/hover/focus states across horizontal, vertical, and line variants.

nodes.name: tabs-content.svelte
nodes.summary: Tab panel content component wrapping bits-ui TabsPrimitive.Content with a bindable ref and minimal styling.
